rationale: Rockstar's official date is Thursday Nov 19, 2026, reaffirmed in its Aug 2026 Extended Look and with preload timing announced. Only unconfirmed 2027 rumors exist. Base rate for a date confirmed under 2 weeks out holding is high, but the question needs release exactly on Nov 19, so a small risk of a last-minute delay or early launch remains.

The Aug 12 eclipse has already happened. No NASA post-event peak figure was found as of Nov 7. NASA's 2024 aggregate peak was 1.46M, the 2017 figure was 2-3M, and the 15M claim comes from a single outlet and is unverified. The 2026 path is mostly outside the US, and if NASA publishes no aggregate by Nov 12 the fallback YouTube-only peak is usually smaller. Strongest counter: the 2017 precedent and a large European audience.

The question asks whether Microsoft Office/365 is still active on Nov 10, 2026. Microsoft announced on Nov 5 that Office 365 A1 is being retired, but its final retirement date is Jan 1, 2028, and the service was operational per StatusGator on Nov 6. Only a sudden full shutdown in 3 days would resolve NO, which is very unlikely. Wording is ambiguous, so a small allowance is kept.

No official listing date as of Nov 7. The SEC has not declared the registration effective, and the price range is undetermined. WSJ and Reuters report a target debut in the week of Nov 16, with pricing around Nov 19-20, and Bloomberg reports a roadshow possibly starting the week of Nov 9. Any slip past Nov 20 resolves NO, and the 15-day public-filing rule could push the timeline later. Strongest case for YES: the reported target week includes Nov 20.

India has said it will not sign the 35-by-35 pledge (Nov 3), and the US is absent from COP31 after withdrawing from the agreement. China is not confirmed in any source, but it has a record of joining voluntary electrification and renewables pledges, and leader-level sign-ons are expected at Antalya (Nov 9-20). The pledge is voluntary and non-binding, which makes Chinese participation plausible. No direct evidence yet of a Chinese sign-on.

Nearly settled: only 3-4 days remain in the window and no nuclear strike has been reported as of Nov 6. The Tucker Carlson claim is unverified, the White House did not confirm a plan, and analysts call a nuclear strike very unlikely. Trump reportedly downplayed further attacks after the Nov 3 midterms.

Tax decisions need unanimity, and Sweden is reported to oppose the pouch minimum tax and may have asked to pull the item from the Nov 9 agenda. A failure would move the file to the Lithuanian presidency in January 2027. Ireland is pushing for a general approach, and the Council text does include nicotine pouches, so a deal with a formal announcement is possible but less likely than not.

Resolves YES only if shares are open for trading by Nov 20 with official filings or exchange confirmation. A schedule slip past Nov 20 is a strong NO path.

Gemini 4 Carbon was announced Oct 28 but is only in limited access (Google's Fairwind cybersecurity program), with no public date for developers or consumers. Qualifying requires general public access within the Nov 9-15 window. Gemini 4 Argon opened to developers about two weeks after its own announcement, so a quick broadening is possible but not yet signaled.

The question resolves YES if released on or before Nov 19, so an early launch also counts, but early launches are rare and a last-minute delay is the main risk.

The blockade was reinstated July 14, 2026. As of Aug 20, Trump said it remains in full force and talks were on hold. The June lifting came only with a signed memorandum. No evidence of a November deal was found, and a qualifying general end announcement within about 8 days would need a fast breakthrough. Current status is unverified past August.

Nearly settled: T CrB has not erupted as of early November 2026, and past predicted windows have lapsed. Only about 3 days remain. Even an eruption historically peaked near magnitude 2-3, well short of the magnitude 5 threshold, so YES is very unlikely.
